notes.title: The official version is now on sale! Use Word and PPT to solve puzzles?
notes.notes:
Developed by Hello World Studio and published by OKJOY, the 2D platform puzzle game "Hello World" is now officially available on Steam!!!

The original price of the game is 2.99$, but for the first two weeks, it is available at a 10% discount for 2.69$. The estimated gameplay time is around 2-3 hours.

Are you both familiar and unfamiliar with office software like Word, PPT, and Excel? During his university years while preparing his graduation project, the developer had a burst of inspiration based on the operations of various office software. Using a game engine, he transformed these dull and monotonous computer applications into a creative and imaginative puzzle game. In this game, players are led by a cursor sprite to explore and navigate within office software. Players will engage in a series of fun interactions with elements such as folders, junk files, Word documents, PPT slides, Excel sheets, and even binary 0 and 1.

The game also contains many hidden pieces of computer knowledge and Easter eggs. Observe carefully and find them in the game! Don't wait any longer, start your journey now!

Click the link below to purchase the game or add it to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2802140/Hello_World/
